content.text:
Seattle's Building Permits dataset (data.seattle.gov, dataset 76t5-zqzr) lists **11 permits** at 400 Broad St.

| Permit | Date applied | Status | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| 6090506-CN | Blank | Closed | No description |
| 6395612-CN | 2014-01-09 | Completed | Addition to the passenger drop-off shelter |
| 6413156-CN | 2014-04-21 | Completed | Replace a non-structural wall on the observation deck |
| 6454495-CN | 2015-02-09 | Completed | New occupant load for assembly spaces |
| 6455765-CN | 2015-04-08 | Completed | Canopy extension over the walkway |
| 6482935-CN | 2015-07-07 | Completed | Reroof south side of the lower portion |
| 6477983-CN | Blank | Closed | Reroof the 100 level |
| 6506865-CN | 2016-10-04 | Completed | Seismic upgrades to the tower |
| 6545059-CN | 2016-11-09 | Completed | Major alterations to the Space Needle |
| 6915193-CN | 2022-11-18 | Issued | Restaurant alterations for elevator modernization |
| 6989255-CN | Blank | Withdrawn | Replace the chain-link material between the stairs and elevator shafts |

- **Withdrawn permit:** I counted 6989255-CN because it was filed, even though it was later withdrawn. If you only want permits that went ahead, the count is 10.
- **Other addresses:** I also searched the descriptions for "Space Needle." That turned up two permits at 223 Taylor Ave N. I left them out because they use a different address.

FINAL ANSWER: 11
